answer.rationale: memory_57 most directly supports the objective because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm. memory_44 links sales-assisted conversion to pipeline quality, though realized revenue and retention are omitted. memory_73 shows strong acquisition and revenue lift, but does not address discount durability, customer quality, margins, or retention. memory_31 reports a durable activation lift, while memory_86 reports better completion, time-to-value, and adoption; both are useful leading indicators but lack direct qualified-revenue or retention evidence. memory_91 is weakest because it only establishes improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action, without durability or downstream revenue-quality evidence.
